verdict.rationale: Sift produces a 0–100 risk score and offers Workflows, a rules automation platform for real-time risk-based decisions. It pairs these with Review Queues and custom Decisions (e.g., Ban Account, Cancel Order) tied to backend actions, which together imply operators can route outcomes such as allow, review and block based on score. However, no evidence explicitly shows configuring score-range thresholds, and nothing mentions a step-up 3DS action. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of score-threshold configuration in Workflows, any step-up 3DS action mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration of threshold tuning.
